data.rationale: The proposal gets the caniuse → MDN → mail draft sequence and subject/body templates right, but it ends with "Send" when the true workflow forbids sending and discards the draft. It also leaves out opening and closing the MDN tab and the "not supported yet" case, and it splits customer into email/name parameters, with the body using {name} instead of the declared recipient_name, so an automation built from it would be mostly concrete but would wrongly send the email.
